title: 脉冲自组织映射与雷达信号去交织
excerpt: 梳理 Spiking Self-Organizing Maps 在无监督雷达脉冲序列聚类和去交织任务中的使用方式。
content:
任务视角

雷达信号去交织通常需要在混合脉冲序列中恢复不同辐射源的结构。脉冲自组织映射提供了一种无监督聚类路径，适合与事件驱动计算范式结合。

en.title: Spiking self-organizing maps for radar signal deinterleaving
en.excerpt: An overview of spiking self-organizing maps for unsupervised radar pulse clustering and deinterleaving.
en.content:
Task perspective

Radar signal deinterleaving seeks to recover the structure of individual emitters from mixed pulse streams. Spiking self-organizing maps offer an unsupervised clustering route compatible with event-driven computation.

Reading focus

Further notes may cover convergence guarantees, competitive learning, and robustness in complex scenarios.
